mtion.isRunning.description: Checks whether mtion studio answered Cuebot the last time Cuebot asked it something.
mtion.isRunning.returns: true when mtion studio answered last time, otherwise false.

mtion.sendTrigger.description: Sets off an external trigger in your open mtion clubhouse, like confetti. It does not fail when mtion studio is closed; check the result instead.

parameters.trigger: The trigger's name in your clubhouse, like "Confetti", or its id.
parameters.parameters: Optional. Values for the trigger, by parameter name, like {"Amount": 5}. Lists of options take the option number.

mtion.sendTrigger.returns: running (mtion studio answered), found (the trigger exists) and sent (it was set off), each true or false.

mtion.getActiveClubhouse.description: Tells you which clubhouse is open in mtion studio right now.
mtion.getActiveClubhouse.returns: id, name and description of the open clubhouse, or null when none is open (or mtion studio is closed).

mtion.getTriggers.description: Lists the external triggers in the clubhouse that is open in mtion studio.
mtion.getTriggers.returns: A list of triggers. Each has id, name and parameters (each with index, name and type).

mtion.getClubhouses.description: Lists every clubhouse of the mtion account that is signed in.
mtion.getClubhouses.returns: A list of clubhouses. Each has id, name and description.
